champion.tips: MALPHITE TIPS AND TRICKS Try and get as much gold and XP as quickly as you can in the early game so you get your level 6 power spike fast. Whenever your Ultimate R is up, try to gank a lane. Each Ultimate R use can result in a kill. Your early game is weak and you can’t 1v1 anyone. If the enemy Jungler invades, run away.
champion.builds: THE BEST MALPHITE BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR JUNGLE IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Malphite Jungle build, you should take Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Press the Attack as your keystone, followed by Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Coup de Grace in the primary tree, as well as Magical Footwear and Cosmic Insight in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Sunfire Aegis as your first item, followed by Plated Steelcaps and Thornmail. For your last 3 items, you should build Kaenic Rookern, Frozen Heart and finish with Jak'Sho, The Protean. For the skill order, you want to stick with W - E - Q. Right now, this build has 52.8% winrate over 5 709 matches played. Optional Your second option for Malphite Jungle build would be to take Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Dark Harvest as your keystone, Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos and Ultimate Hunter in the primary tree, and Axiom Arcanist with Transcendence in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Malignance, which you should build first, followed by Sorcerer's Shoes as your second item and Stormsurge as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Shadowflame, Rabadon's Deathcap and Void Staff. The skill order for this build is Q - E - W. In the current patch, this build has a 45.2% win rate over 4 035 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells, with runes being First Strike as your keystone, Cash Back, Triple Tonic and Cosmic Insight in the primary tree, and Sudden Impact with Ultimate Hunter in the secondary tree, as well as Attack Speed, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Malignance as your first item, then Sorcerer's Shoes as a second item and Stormsurge as a third item. You want to finish the build with Shadowflame, Rabadon's Deathcap and Void Staff. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - E - W. This build is currently sitting at a 47.4% win rate across 928 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Malphite Jungle build in the current patch, try Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells, Electrocute, Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos and Ultimate Hunter as your primary rune tree, and Axiom Arcanist with Transcendence as your secondary tree. Use Attack Speed, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Malignance as your first item, then finish Sorcerer's Shoes as your second item, and Stormsurge as third item. The last 3 options are Shadowflame, Rabadon's Deathcap and Void Staff. The ability order for this build is Q - E - W. As of the current patch, this build has a 46.2% win rate over 857 matches played. Situational Malphite Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Malphite build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Malphite runes page.
